Proposition
1. ch7:7.2The Levi-Civita connection of every flat Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold satisfies the flatness criterion.

Proof

\sketch The Euclidean and pseudo-Euclidean connections satisfy (7.3) by the coordinate calculation above. Naturality of the Levi-Civita connection transfers this identity through each local isometry to a model space.
